loyal.name: Loyal
loyal.description: Sticks by the captain when others waver.

ambitious.name: Ambitious
ambitious.description: Wants a ship, a title, a share of something bigger.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.description: Counts every coin of their share, and yours.

brave.name: Brave
brave.description: Leads from the front in a boarding.

bloodthirsty.name: Bloodthirsty
bloodthirsty.description: Enjoys a fight a little too much. Resents mercy shown to prisoners.

superstitious.name: Superstitious
superstitious.description: Reads omens in every gull and green flash. Panics when they turn bad.

drunkard.name: Drunkard
drunkard.description: Never far from the rum cask.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.description: Dice below decks. Wins friends, loses shares, starts fights.

honest.name: Honest
honest.description: Says what they think and keeps their word.

schemer.name: Schemer
schemer.description: Always working an angle. Classic mutiny material.

devout.name: Devout
devout.description: Prays before battle. Dislikes sacking churches.

green.name: Green
green.description: New to the sea. Learns fast, panics faster.

hot_headed.name: Hot-headed
hot_headed.description: Quick to anger, quicker with a blade.

popular.name: Popular
popular.description: Everyone's mate. Their death or punishment hits morale hard.

seasick.name: Seasick
seasick.description: Green at the gills in any swell.

former_navy.name: Former navy
former_navy.description: Knows gun drill and discipline. May not love pirates.

family_man.name: Family man
family_man.description: Has someone waiting ashore. Wants a pardon more than a gallows.

reformer.name: Reformer
reformer.description: Means to clean up the colony.

loyal_to_crown.name: Loyal to the Crown
loyal_to_crown.description: The King's servant first and always.

pirate_sympathizer.name: Pirate sympathizer
pirate_sympathizer.description: Looks the other way, for friends of the Brethren.

scarred.name: Scarred
scarred.description: A blade left its mark across the face.

one_eyed.name: One-eyed
one_eyed.description: Lost an eye to a splinter. Wears a patch and a glare.

peg_leg.name: Peg leg
peg_leg.description: A round shot took the leg below the knee.

hook_hand.name: Hook
hook_hand.description: An iron hook where a hand used to be.
